about.overviewBody: Visionary Masters Global Pvt Ltd combines nearly two decades of hands-on operational experience with modern intelligent business support. Founded on the principle that real-world discipline and cutting-edge technology together deliver results traditional agencies can't match, we help businesses streamline their operations, reporting, and communication — faster and smarter.
about.founderNoteBody: Our founder, Vineet Grover, spent 18 years in the high-pressure world of live events — where there's no room for delay and every detail counts. That discipline now shapes how Visionary Masters Global operates: reliable, detail-driven, and powered by smart tools that get things done faster.

services.sectionSubtitle: Eight practical services built to keep your business running smoothly.
services.aiCapabilitiesTitle: Powered by Modern Tools, Grounded in Experience
services.aiCapabilitiesBody: Every service is backed by modern tools — from generative design to autonomous workflows — combined with 18 years of real operational discipline.

items.title: Voice Assistants & Appointment Booking
items.shortDescription: Answer customer calls, collect details and book appointments with a voice assistant connected to your process.
items.whatItIs: A custom voice assistant that handles incoming calls, answers common questions, captures customer information and books appointments using your business rules.
whatsIncluded: Call flow designed around your customer journey
Answers for common customer questions
Appointment booking and customer-detail capture
Excel or Google Sheets record automation
items.outcome: Customers receive a quick, consistent response while your team spends less time answering repetitive calls and entering booking details.

items.title: Power BI Dashboards & Business Reporting
items.shortDescription: Interactive Power BI dashboards that turn sales and operations data into clear, actionable insight.
items.whatItIs: Interactive, visually clean Power BI dashboards built from your existing data sources — sales, operations, finance, or marketing — so decision-makers can see what matters at a glance.
whatsIncluded: Data connection and cleanup from Excel, SQL, or cloud sources
Custom dashboard design with KPIs relevant to your business
Drill-down reports and filters for deeper analysis
Scheduled refresh setup so data stays current
items.outcome: A single, reliable source of truth for business performance — no more digging through spreadsheets.

items.title: ATS-Friendly Resume Builder Solutions
items.shortDescription: Resume tools that help job seekers create organised, role-specific and ATS-friendly applications.
items.whatItIs: A custom resume-building solution that helps job seekers organise their experience, match relevant job requirements and prepare a clean resume for applicant tracking systems.
whatsIncluded: Guided collection of skills and work experience
Role-specific resume content suggestions
ATS-friendly structure and formatting
Export-ready resume output
items.outcome: A faster, clearer way for job seekers to prepare relevant resumes without struggling with structure and formatting.

items.title: Excel Automation & MIS Reporting
items.shortDescription: Custom Excel trackers, smart workbooks and recurring MIS reports built around your exact workflow.
items.whatItIs: Purpose-built Excel workbooks — trackers, calculators, inventory sheets, budget tools — designed around how your team actually works, with formulas and automation that remove manual effort.
whatsIncluded: Custom tracker or workbook design from scratch
Formula automation, conditional formatting, and data validation
Dashboards and summary views within the workbook
Training on how to use and maintain the sheet
items.outcome: Less manual data entry, fewer errors, and a tool your team will actually keep using.

items.title: Business Presentations & Pitch Decks
items.shortDescription: Polished, professional presentations that communicate your message clearly and confidently.
items.whatItIs: Business presentations — pitch decks, board updates, client proposals, training material — designed for clarity and visual impact, built or refined using assisted design tools.
whatsIncluded: Slide structure and storyline built around your key message
Professional, on-brand visual design
Chart and data visualization for supporting numbers
Speaker notes and formatting for different audiences
items.outcome: A presentation that lands the message clearly and leaves a professional impression.

items.title: Business Websites & Landing Pages
items.shortDescription: Clean, fast, mobile-friendly websites for businesses that need an online presence without the overhead.
items.whatItIs: Simple, professional websites — landing pages, small business sites, portfolio sites — built fast, mobile-responsive, and easy to maintain.
whatsIncluded: Custom design matched to your brand
Mobile-responsive layout and fast load times
Contact forms, maps, and essential business information
Deployment and basic hosting guidance
items.outcome: A professional online presence live in days, not months.

items.title: Ad Images, Videos & Voiceovers
items.shortDescription: Generated advertising images, videos and voiceovers for campaigns, promotions and social media.
items.whatItIs: Short-form and business videos created using modern generation tools — including natural-sounding AI voiceovers — for marketing, product explainers, and internal training.
whatsIncluded: Script writing and storyboard planning
Generated visuals and video sequences
Natural voiceover in the language and tone you need
Editing, captions, and export in the right format for each platform
items.outcome: Professional-looking video content produced faster and at a fraction of traditional production cost.

items.title: Workflow Automation (N8N)
items.shortDescription: Automated workflows that connect your tools and eliminate repetitive manual work.
items.whatItIs: Custom automation workflows built on N8N that connect your apps, forms, spreadsheets, and communication tools — so repetitive tasks run themselves.
whatsIncluded: Workflow mapping to identify automation opportunities
Custom N8N workflows connecting your existing tools
Automated notifications, data syncing, and report generation
Ongoing monitoring and refinement
items.outcome: Hours of manual, repetitive work handled automatically — freeing your team to focus on higher-value work.
